claims.assertion: Mari Swa reports about 977 large starships in Earth orbit and alleges some Orion Grey craft may use false transponder identities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She attributes the estimate to Taygetan intelligence and calls the identity concern speculative.

claims.assertion: Mari says Federation rules restrict human and Reptilian travel between Earth and space, with some alleged exceptions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says underground portals may allow some groups to bypass the restriction.

review_flags: The source consists of unverified claims about extraterrestrial traffic and a Federation travel blockade.
coverage_gaps: Other sections discuss alleged Orion-Reptilian cooperation and Alcyone Council plans.
